title: Kotoba Rain difficulty tuning
changes: Reads the controlled Japanese word aloud when a new Kotoba Rain round begins.
Limits Kotoba Rain to a maximum of three falling choices at once: one correct word and up to two distractors.
Slows the opening falling speed from roughly 5.2 seconds to 6.4 seconds and makes the difficulty ramp gentler.
Keeps a minimum fall duration of 3.2 seconds so late rounds remain playable.
Retains all v11.4 Adaptive Learning, Campfire Recall and Classic-only Activity Landmark changes.
Bumped release-controlled assets and service-worker caches to v11.4.3.
